+package trafficpolicy
+
+import (
+	"fmt"

+	envoyroutev3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/config/route/v3"

+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/pkg/utils/regexutils"
+)
+
+type consistentHashIR struct {
+	hashPolicies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	disable      bool
+}
+
+var _ PolicySubIR = &consistentHashIR{}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	otherConsistentHash, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c == nil || otherConsistentHash == nil {
+		return c == nil && otherConsistentHash == nil
+	}
+	if c.disable != otherConsistentHash.disable {
+		return false
+	}
+	if !slices.EqualFunc(c.hashPolicies, otherConsistentHash.hashPolicies, func(a, b *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) bool {
+		return proto.Equal(a, b)
+	}) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	for _, hp := range c.hashPolicies {
+		if h := hp.GetHeader(); h != nil && h.GetRegexRewrite() != nil && h.GetRegexRewrite().GetPattern() != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(h.GetRegexRewrite().GetPattern().GetRegex()); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern: %w", err)
+			}
+		}
+		if err := hp.ValidateAll(); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) clone() *consistentHashIR {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	out := &consistentHashIR{
+		disable: c.disable,
+	}
+	if len(c.hashPolicies) > 0 {
+		out.hashPolicies = make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, len(c.hashPolicies))
+		for i, hp := range c.hashPolicies {
+			out.hashPolicies[i] = proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy)
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+
+func defaultSourceIPHashPolicy() *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	return &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+		PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{

+				SourceIp: true,
+			},
+		},
+		Terminal: false,
+	}
+}
+
+func parseCookieTTL(ttl string) (time.Duration, error) {
+	if secs, err := strconv.ParseInt(ttl, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		if secs < 0 {
+			return 0, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl must not be negative: %q", ttl)
+		}
+		return time.Duration(secs) * time.Second, nil
+	}
+	d, err := time.ParseDuration(ttl)
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: %w", ttl, err)
+	}
+	if d < 0 {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl must not be negative: %q", ttl)
+	}
+	return d, nil
+}
+
+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) error {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+	if ptr.Deref(ch.Disable, false) {
+		if len(ch.Headers) > 0 || len(ch.Cookies) > 0 || len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 || len(ch.FilterState) > 0 || ch.SourceIP != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("consistentHash: no other fields may be set when disable is true")
+		}
+		out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+			disable: true,
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	var hashPolicies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	// 1. Headers (case-insensitive deduplication by headerName, preserving first occurrence casing)
+	seenHeaders := sets.New[string]()
+	for _, h := range ch.Headers {
+		if h.HeaderName == "" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("consistentHash: headerName cannot be empty")
+		}
+		key := strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)
+		if seenHeaders.Has(key) {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenHeaders.Insert(key)
+
+		headerPolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+			HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			if h.RegexRewrite.Pattern == "" {
+				return fmt.Errorf("consistentHash: header regexRewrite pattern cannot be empty")
+			}
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(h.RegexRewrite.Pattern); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("consistentHash: invalid regex pattern %q: %w", h.RegexRewrite.Pattern, err)
+			}
+			headerPolicy.RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+				Header: headerPolicy,
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(h.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 2. Cookies (deduplicated by name, keeping first occurrence)
+	seenCookies := sets.New[string]()
+	for _, c := range ch.Cookies {
+		if c.Name == "" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("consistentHash: cookie name cannot be empty")
+		}
+		if seenCookies.Has(c.Name) {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenCookies.Insert(c.Name)
+
+		cookiePolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+			Name: c.Name,
+		}
+		if c.TTL != nil && *c.TTL != "" {
+			d, err := parseCookieTTL(*c.TTL)
+			if err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("consistentHash: %w", err)
+			}
+			cookiePolicy.Ttl = durationpb.New(d)
+		}
+		if c.Path != nil {
+			cookiePolicy.Path = *c.Path
+		}
+		if len(c.Attributes) > 0 {
+			attrs := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, 0, len(c.Attributes))
+			for _, attr := range c.Attributes {
+				attrs = append(attrs, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+					Name:  attr.Name,
+					Value: attr.Value,
+				})
+			}
+			cookiePolicy.Attributes = attrs
+		}
+
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+				Cookie: cookiePolicy,
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(c.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 3. QueryParameters (deduplicated by name, keeping first occurrence)
+	seenQueryParams := sets.New[string]()
+	for _, qp := range ch.QueryParameters {
+		if qp.Name == "" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("consistentHash: queryParameter name cannot be empty")
+		}
+		if seenQueryParams.Has(qp.Name) {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenQueryParams.Insert(qp.Name)
+
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+					Name: qp.Name,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(qp.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 4. FilterState (deduplicated by key, keeping first occurrence)
+	seenFilterState := sets.New[string]()
+	for _, fs := range ch.FilterState {
+		if fs.Key == "" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("consistentHash: filterState key cannot be empty")
+		}
+		if seenFilterState.Has(fs.Key) {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenFilterState.Insert(fs.Key)
+
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+					Key: fs.Key,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(fs.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 5. SourceIP
+	if ch.SourceIP != nil {
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(ch.SourceIP.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	// Default to a single sourceIp hash policy with terminal=false when no sub-fields are specified
+	if len(hashPolicies) == 0 {
+		hashPolicies = []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			defaultSourceIPHashPolicy(),
+		}
+	}
+
+	out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+		hashPolicies: hashPolicies,
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func applyConsistentHash(consistentHash *consistentHashIR, out *envoyroutev3.Route) {
+	if consistentHash == nil || out == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	action := out.GetRoute()
+	if action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if consistentHash.disable {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+	if len(consistentHash.hashPolicies) == 0 {
+		action.HashPolicy = []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			defaultSourceIPHashPolicy(),
+		}
+		return
+	}
+	action.HashPolicy = consistentHash.hashPolicies
+}
+
+func unionConsistentHash(high, low *consistentHashIR) *consistentHashIR {
+	var (
+		headers      []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+		cookies      []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+		queryParams  []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+		filterStates []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+		sourceIP     *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+		seenHeaders      = sets.New[string]()
+		seenCookies      = sets.New[string]()
+		seenQueryParams  = sets.New[string]()
+		seenFilterStates = sets.New[string]()
+	)
+
+	addPolicies := func(policies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, includeSourceIP bool) {
+		for _, hp := range policies {
+			cloned := proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy)
+			switch spec := cloned.GetPolicySpecifier().(type) {
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_:
+				key := strings.ToLower(spec.Header.GetHeaderName())
+				if !seenHeaders.Has(key) {
+					seenHeaders.Insert(key)
+					headers = append(headers, cloned)
+				}
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_:
+				key := spec.Cookie.GetName()
+				if !seenCookies.Has(key) {
+					seenCookies.Insert(key)
+					cookies = append(cookies, cloned)
+				}
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_:
+				key := spec.QueryParameter.GetName()
+				if !seenQueryParams.Has(key) {
+					seenQueryParams.Insert(key)
+					queryParams = append(queryParams, cloned)
+				}
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_:
+				key := spec.FilterState.GetKey()
+				if !seenFilterStates.Has(key) {
+					seenFilterStates.Insert(key)
+					filterStates = append(filterStates, cloned)
+				}
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_:
+				if includeSourceIP && sourceIP == nil {
+					sourceIP = cloned
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	addPolicies(high.hashPolicies, true)
+	addPolicies(low.hashPolicies, false)
+
+	merged := slices.Concat(headers, cookies, queryParams, filterStates)
+	if sourceIP != nil {
+		merged = append(merged, sourceIP)
+	}
+
+	return &consistentHashIR{
+		hashPolicies: merged,
+	}
+}
